associations.rationale: The monoid homomorphism from unit quaternions to SU(2) constructs the comparison map but does not itself state that it is an identification.
Injectivity is one prerequisite for turning the comparison homomorphism into the claimed identification.
Surjectivity is one prerequisite for turning the comparison homomorphism into the claimed identification.
The type directly asserts a multiplicative equivalence between the unit quaternions and SU(2).
